crossRefs.note: They laid hands on them, and put them in custody until the next day, for it was now evening.
But Saul ravaged the assembly, entering into every house and dragged both men and women off to prison.
Peter therefore was kept in the prison, but constant prayer was made by the assembly to God for him.
When they had laid many stripes on them, they threw them into prison, charging the jailer to keep them safely,
But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and will persecute you, delivering you up to synagogues…
Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself.) I am more so: in labors more abundantly, in prisons more…
Others were tried by mocking and scourging, yes, moreover by bonds and imprisonment.
Don’t be afraid of the things which you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into…

translations.web: and laid hands on the apostles, then put them in public custody.
translations.bsb: and arrested the apostles and put them in the public jail.
translations.kjv: And laid their hands on the apostles, and put them in the common prison.
translations.asv: and laid hands on the apostles, and put them in public ward.
